evals.prompt: Inspect this Figma frame and save a 2x PNG: https://www.figma.com/design/AbCdEf123456/Example?node-id=12-34
evals.expected_output: Uses figma screenshot with full URL, scale 2, and explicit output file; relies on automatic file-key and node-id parsing.
assertions: Response does not manually download or decode base64

evals.prompt: Show only node 4:56 from Figma file AbCdEf123456, two levels deep, then summarize its layout.
evals.expected_output: Uses figma nodes with file key, node ID, and --depth 2, then reads returned JSON without fetching whole file.
assertions: Command uses figma nodes with file key AbCdEf123456 and node 4:56 (or 4-56)

evals.prompt: List published components for team 123456 and follow next page cursor 7890.
evals.expected_output: Uses figma team components with team ID, --after 7890, and optionally a page size; explains cursor comes from meta.cursor.after.
assertions: Response identifies meta.cursor.after as pagination source

evals.prompt: Post 'Approved for handoff' on this Figma file.
evals.expected_output: Treats comment creation as write, confirms target and intent unless explicitly told to execute, then uses figma comment URL with exact text.
assertions: Response treats comment as write requiring confirmation
Response does not use raw API when friendly command exists
